blocking.title: A refused peace is escaped in one click: declaring war on one's partner in a war ends that war at once, all occupation undone, no peace, no truce, no log line

blocking.fix: A nation must not leave a war by declaring a new one (PLAN 7.188's leaveWarsWhere in declareWar). Where an attacker would stand against a nation it fights beside, refuse the declaration or keep that nation out of the new war, rather than pull the attacker out of the old one; if it must leave, leave as a peace would (the enemy's acceptance, a truce, and a log row 'X left the war with Y').
